title: Matt LaFleur jokes he'll "throw down" with his brother if there's an issue in Cardinals joint practice

sources.title: Matt LaFleur jokes he'll "throw down" with his brother if there's an issue in Cardinals joint practice
sources.description: Fights at joint practices are nothing new in the NFL, but a fracas in this week's workout with the Packers and Cardinals would present a different wrinkle than we're accustomed to seeing.
